title: Homepage Load and Content Verification
description: Verify that the homepage loads successfully, displays hero content, key product and service highlights, and navigation elements correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
Check that hero section is visible with correct headline and call to action
Verify presence of featured products and services highlights
Verify main navigation menu, including vertical mega-menu, is visible and functional
Verify page title and SEO metadata are present and correct
Check page load time is under 2 seconds on 4G network simulation

title: Navigation Accessibility and Responsiveness
description: Verify the main navigation system is fully accessible with keyboard and screen readers and responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage
Use keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow keys) to navigate through the main menu including the vertical mega-menu
Ensure all menu items receive focus and submenus can be expanded/collapsed via keyboard
Validate all menu items have proper ARIA roles and labels for screen readers
Resize viewport to simulate tablet and mobile devices
Confirm navigation adapts visually and remains fully functional across all tested viewport sizes

title: Product Pages Content and SEO Metadata Validation
description: Verify each product page loads correctly, displays all required technical details, intellectual property information, and that SEO metadata including JSON-LD structured data is correct.

steps.description: Navigate to each individual product page URL (e.g., DELIA, BiasGuard, LASOF, etc.)
Verify product description, use cases, and mathematical guarantees content is present and correctly formatted
Verify presence of intellectual property and technology explanations
Check SEO title, description, canonical tags, OpenGraph and Twitter card metadata correctness
Validate JSON-LD structured data for product is present and passes Google Rich Results test
Check page load performance and accessibility scores meet threshold

title: Service Pages Navigation and Content Check
description: Confirm that the services overview and individual service pages load correctly with descriptive content and proper navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to the services overview page
Verify list of services is displayed with brief summaries
Click each service link to open the corresponding detailed service page
Confirm detailed descriptions and technical info are present and formatted correctly
Verify navigation allows easy return to overview and other pages

title: Methodology Pages Technical Content and SEO Verification
description: Validate that methodology overview and specific methodology pages (SCM, AI Capsule, MRCF) correctly display deep technical insights and have valid SEO structured data.

steps.description: Navigate to the methodologies overview page
Verify list and summaries of methodologies are present
Open each individual methodology page
Check for detailed technical content specific to each methodology
Validate presence and correctness of SEO metadata and JSON-LD schema
Ensure load times and accessibility standards are met

title: Article System Functionality and SEO Metadata Generation
description: Verify that the dynamic articles system loads articles correctly with markdown rendering, images, and auto-generated SEO metadata including OpenGraph and Twitter cards.

steps.description: Navigate to the articles listing page
Check that articles list is visible with titles and summaries
Select and open an individual article
Verify markdown content is rendered correctly, including embedded images
Check SEO metadata tags, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, and structured data are generated and valid

title: Secure Contact Forms Submission and Confirmation
description: Test multiple secure contact forms across the site to confirm data submission via Resend API, show user confirmation, and ensure email is received by FERZ team, handling staging and production environments.

steps.description: Navigate to each contact form available across site pages
Fill out contact form fields with valid, valid edge case, and invalid inputs
Submit the form
Validate form submission triggers and user sees submission confirmation message
Verify email was sent successfully to configured FERZ team email via Resend API in both staging and production (mock or monitor email deliveries)
Check form handles invalid inputs gracefully with appropriate error messages

title: PDF Library Resource Download Functionality
description: Validate that PDF documents in the resource library can be downloaded correctly and links are functional and accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the PDF library section/page
Verify list of PDF resources is displayed, showing titles and descriptions
Click on each PDF download link
Ensure the respective PDF file downloads successfully without corruption
Check accessibility of download links (keyboard focusable, screen reader friendly)

title: Legal Pages Presence and Compliance
description: Verify that all required legal pages (Privacy Policy, Disclaimer, Terms) are present, accessible, contain FERZ compliant content, and pass accessibility standards.

steps.description: Navigate to Privacy Policy page
Verify content is complete and compliant with specifications
Navigate to Disclaimer page
Verify content correctness and completeness
Check presence and content of Terms page
Verify all legal pages are accessible and meet WCAG standards

title: SEO Structured Data and Rich Results Validation Across Site
description: Test that key pages output valid JSON-LD structured data, titles, descriptions and canonical URLs, and pass Google Rich Results Test to maximize online visibility.

steps.description: Load homepage and key pages including product, services, methodologies, article detail, and legal pages
Extract SEO metadata tags and JSON-LD scripts
Validate metadata correctness for title, meta description, canonical URL, OpenGraph, Twitter cards
Run Google Rich Results test on JSON-LD structured data for each page and confirm no errors or warnings

title: Accessibility Compliance Validation Across Site
description: Verify that the entire website meets WCAG accessibility standards, including semantic HTML structure, keyboard navigation, ARIA labeling, color contrast, and screen reader compatibility.

steps.description: Navigate through site pages using keyboard only
Confirm all interactive elements receive keyboard focus in a logical order
Verify all images and media have appropriate alt text or labels
Check ARIA labels and roles presence for dynamic components such as menus, forms, and accordions
Use color contrast analyzer to check contrast ratios meet WCAG AA or better standards
Test screen reader announcements for navigational and form components

title: Site Performance and Lighthouse Audit
description: Confirm that all audited pages achieve Lighthouse scores of 90+ in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO with optimizations like lazy loading, optimized fonts, and tree shaking.

steps.description: Perform Lighthouse audits on homepage, product pages, services, methodologies, article detail, and contact pages
Verify Performance score is 90 or above
Verify Accessibility score is 90 or above
Verify Best Practices score is 90 or above
Verify SEO score is 90 or above
Observe that images use lazy loading and fonts are optimized with minimal blocking

title: Staging Authentication System Verification
description: Test the staging environment authentication system to ensure non-production environments are protected and properly display authentication UI as intended.

steps.description: Access staging environment of the website
Confirm authentication prompt or mechanism appears to restrict access
Attempt access with valid and invalid credentials (if applicable)
Ensure authentication success grants access and failures deny access with appropriate messages
Check authentication UI is accessible and responsive

title: 404 Not Found Page Functionality and Styling
description: Verify that accessing unknown routes shows the custom 404 error page with correct message, navigation options back to known pages, and styling consistent with site branding.

steps.description: Navigate to a non-existent URL path on the site
Check that custom 404 page loads with appropriate error message
Verify that user is offered navigation back to homepage or key pages
Confirm page styling and layout match site branding

title: ESLint Compliance and Code Quality Validation
description: Run ESLint on all source code files to confirm absence of critical or high-severity issues and verify adherence to defined coding standards and rules.

steps.description: Execute ESLint across the entire codebase
Verify zero critical or high-severity linting errors
Ensure consistent formatting and adherence to style rules
